paragraphs: The stock price of Fermi Inc. is 2.54, with a decrease of 0.39% from the prior close and 40.38% over the last 21 sessions. The price data is as of October 26, 2026.

There have been recent filings, including a Form 4 on October 22, 2026, and a Form 144 on October 20, 2026. Additionally, an 8-K filing was made on October 16, 2026, announcing an amendment to the Equipment Supply Loan Financing Agreement with MUFG Bank, Ltd.
